deadlines.description: The hotel must confirm the booking within this time after you book.
The latest the hotel can record you as checked in, counted from the check-in time.
How long you have, from the check-in time, to dispute a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room).
How long the hotel has after checkout to claim against your deposit.
How long you have after checkout to dispute a claim or a problem with the stay. After this, silence counts as agreement.
How long the arbiter has to rule once a dispute is open. If it misses this deadline, the chargeback-style default for your dispute applies: the money in dispute comes back to you.

whoCanMoveMoney.plain: the hotel and the arbiter together
you, the hotel and the policy co-signer together

silence.description: The hotel never confirmed in time: the guest gets the room money back automatically, with anything else in the account.
The guest never checked in and never disputed: the hotel is paid the room automatically, and anything else in the account goes back to the guest.
Nobody claimed or disputed after checkout: the room goes to the hotel and the deposit (plus anything extra) back to the guest, automatically.

You disputed a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room) and the arbiter missed its deadline: like a card chargeback, you get a full refund of the room, any deposit and the dispute bond, automatically.

You disputed the hotel's claim against your deposit (or the stay, after checkout or in its last night, or a problem on arrival after you checked in and paid the deposit) and the arbiter missed its deadline: the claim is rejected. The hotel gets the room (less the fee); your deposit and the dispute bond come back to you, automatically.

You disputed the stay mid-stay and the arbiter missed its deadline: the nights after the one you disputed in are refunded. The hotel gets the nights up to and including the night you disputed in (less the fee); the remaining nights, your deposit and the dispute bond come back to you, automatically. Signed once per night; stays over 14 nights have no such ending and wait for the arbiter.

deviations.title: Time to dispute after checkout
deviations.why: This is how long you have to answer a deposit claim or report a problem. If it's short, your silence costs you before you even notice: an unanswered claim stands.

deviations.title: Deposit size
deviations.why: A deposit above half the room price is unusual. It's held for the whole stay and can be claimed against.
deviations.expected: at most 50% of the room price
